title: Fit-balanced linear probes as a prior-free decision rule
question: M1.41-M1.45 的 default / test-prior / fit-prior 阈值都没有在低 hate 先验语料上给出可部署的改进。M1.42 已证明 fit-prior 分位点不能搬运，M1.45 显示 5.7% 先验下 default 阈值几乎不预测 hate。M1.46 改问一个 inductive、决策时不依赖 test 分数/先验的问题：只用 fit 标签估计类别权重（class_weight=balanced），固定默认阈值，是否能在 HateXplain、TweetEval/hate、Davidson 三个语料上提高 macro-F1 与 hate recall，并且量化臂相对 f32 是否仍保持质量？

motivation.prior_free: 决策时只使用 fit 标签与固定阈值；不使用 test 分数分位点、test 先验或 test 标签。类别权重在 fit 内估计，属于 inductive cost-sensitive learning，不是 transductive 阈值匹配。
motivation.why_balanced: 低先验语料上 accuracy 被多数类主导，default 阈值 hate recall 只有 3.9%-20.0%（M1.45）。balanced 重加权是标准线性 probe 修正，不改变冻结编码器，也不引入 MLP/微调。
motivation.not_a_threshold_tweak: 本轮不做阈值搜索、不做 calibration、不做 target_prior；只比较同一 C 下的 unweighted 与 balanced 两个 probe。

modeling.c_selection: f32 only, 5-fold StratifiedKFold on fit, unweighted accuracy; C is selected once per corpus/depth/probe/seed and shared by unweighted, balanced, and quantized arms

design.arms: same as corpora: l12 f32/r12, l6 f32/rescan
design.primary_cells: 3 corpora x 2 depths x 2 probes = 12 cells
design.primary_contrast: balanced f32 - unweighted f32, macro-F1, full test
design.primary_bootstrap: 10,000 paired test-level bootstrap, 95% two-sided CI, per cell
design.primary_verdict: a cell is supported if 5/5 seed CIs are entirely above 0; directional if 4/5; otherwise not_supported. The rule is supported if at least 10/12 cells are supported and every corpus has at least 3/4 supported cells.
secondary: accuracy, hate recall, non-hate recall, predicted positive rate for both rules and all arms
balanced arm - balanced f32 macro-F1/accuracy: does quantization retain quality under the prior-free rule
unweighted vs balanced for the quantized arm: does the rule change the arm ranking
per-corpus prior and predicted positive rate to diagnose calibration vs reweighting

boundaries: No test-prior, target_prior, fit-prior quantile, calibration curve, or threshold search.
No MLP, no encoder fine-tuning, no MNLI.
No new corpus or new embedding; reuse M1.41/M1.42/M1.45 encodings.
Balanced class weights are estimated from fit labels only; this is inductive, not transductive.
Candidate line remains closed: even if balanced improves f32 macro-F1, a quantized candidate must pass a separate preregistered confirmatory before upgrade.

expected_readout.if_supported: Report balanced as a valid prior-free decision rule and report whether it closes the low-recall gap without a quantized gain.
expected_readout.if_not_supported: Report that class weighting does not transport across these corpora and keep default/f32 as the anchor.
expected_readout.never: Do not call balanced a candidate rescue, a calibration fix, or a universal default without cross-corpus support.
